selectionMethod: A small NestJS-style booking refund fixture kept outside analyzer development fixtures. The positive case and unsupported-syntax case are labeled from their pinned source before running this evaluator. This curated case is a regression set, not a random sample or external generalization estimate.

cases.title: diagnoses unsupported assertions and nested callbacks

limitations: No runtime test execution, coverage, pass/fail, or business-rule correctness is measured.
The fixture is curated and locally authored; results do not estimate accuracy across repositories.
Undiagnosed unsupported syntax outside the listed negative controls is not measured.
The fixture commit context is a content-derived test snapshot token, not an upstream VCS commit SHA.
A second human has not independently adjudicated these labels.
